description: Products whose price dropped the most in the last N hours across Indian retailers. Use for 'deals today', 'what got cheaper' or 'price drops on phones'. For a product type, pass `category` as a plain name (e.g. 'air conditioners', 'mobile phones', 'laptops') in the same call — no need to look up an id first. With a category, products are ranked by the rupee drop; without one, by the percentage drop. Each product's priceChange is the drop in INR (negative). Shown to the user as product cards.

category.description: Category name, e.g. 'air conditioners' or 'mobile phones'

category_id.description: Category group id from browse_categories (alternative to category)

name: top_price_drops

category.description: Category the drops are limited to

atLowestPrice.description: True when the current price is the lowest ever recorded

id.description: CheapestInIndia product id — pass through unchanged

lowestPrice.description: Lowest price ever recorded by CheapestInIndia, INR

mrp.description: Maximum retail price in INR, when known

priceChange.description: Most recent price change in INR (negative = price dropped, positive = went up)

productPageUrl.description: CheapestInIndia price-history page — use for citations

productUrl.description: Attributed buy link (CheapestInIndia redirect to the retailer)

title: Biggest recent price drops
